provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

state_model: E_J/kB=theta_rot*J*(J+1), statistical weight2*J+1 for every integer J=0..30. No nuclear-spin restrictions, electronic/vibrational states or rotational symmetry division. This finite state list is the exact declared comparison model; it is not an ortho/para mixture of a named molecule.
quantum_definitions: q=sum_J weight*exp(-E_J/(kB*T)); Cv/R=Var(E_J/kB)/T^2 with normalized Boltzmann weights. Classical high-temperature approximations are q_classical=T/theta_rot and Cv_classical/R=1.
qualification: A listed temperature qualifies only when BOTH abs(q_classical/q_quantum-1)<=.01 and abs(Cv_classical/Cv_quantum-1)<=.01. Return the lowest qualifying listed temperature. Only the listed temperatures are candidates.
scope: Rotational freezing and classical-approximation qualification in the stated finite model, without experimental spin conversion or extrapolating its state cutoff to arbitrarily high T.
